caption: The drawing depicts a black tall cylindrical hat with a wide brim. On the front of the hat, there is an illustration of a bald eagle with its wings spread wide. Behind the eagle, there are yellow rays radiating outward, creating a glowing effect. A red ribbon with yellow text encircles the eagle; the visible text on the ribbon reads "COLUMBIA HOSE CO." The hat also features a yellow band around its base. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner with the name "E. H. Shullin" and dated "15/37." The background of the image is a plain, light tan color.
title: Fireman's Hat
